reason: Internal: a design bundle only (design/evaluation/), no code. Records that the eight eval drivers each compose their own subject, that one drifted into a bare model on doctrine text and was reported as her behaviour, and that the drift is a symptom of there being no shared subject rather than a separate mistake. Proposes the inverse of the requirement document withdrawn the same day (PR #307): not a list of seams a suite may substitute, but a shape in which a suite substitutes nothing — Nora built once, a selection of which runtime to watch, input, and the stores as config behind it, with the experiment living in the worktree rather than in the suite. 01-the-runner answers the first question with a measurement: the production composition root IS drivable (tests/test_composition.py calls it ~90 times) and the second builder exists because of an import boundary, not a technical limit. No decision is taken; the first one is the operator's.
